details.question: How many customers do we have?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM public.customers

details.question: How many products are there in each category?
details.sql:
SELECT    p.category,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM public.products p
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

details.question: How many orders have status cancelled?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders
FROM public.orders
WHERE status = 'cancelled'

details.question: List the distinct cities our customers live in.
details.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT city
FROM public.customers
ORDER BY city

details.question: What is the most expensive product? Give its name and price.
details.sql:
SELECT
    p.name,
    p.price
FROM public.products AS p
ORDER BY p.price DESC
LIMIT 1

details.question: What is the average product price, rounded to 2 decimals?
details.sql:
SELECT round(avg(price)::numeric, 2) AS average_price
FROM public.products

details.question: How many customers are in each city?
details.sql:
SELECT
    city,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM public.customers
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY customer_count DESC

details.question: How many business customers are there?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS business_customer_count
FROM public.customers
WHERE segment = 'business'

details.question: Count orders by status.
details.sql:
SELECT
    o.status,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM public.orders o
GROUP BY o.status
ORDER BY order_count DESC

details.question: What is the total quantity of items sold across all orders?
details.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM public.order_items oi

details.question: What is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) across all order items, rounded to 2 decimals?
details.sql:
SELECT round(SUM(quantity * unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue
FROM public.order_items

details.question: What is the total revenue from delivered orders only, rounded to 2 decimals?
details.sql:
WITH delivered_items AS (
    SELECT oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS line_revenue
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT round(sum(line_revenue)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue
FROM delivered_items

details.question: Revenue by product category, rounded to 2 decimals.
details.sql:
WITH revenue_by_category AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT
    category,
    ROUND(total_revenue, 2) AS revenue
FROM revenue_by_category
ORDER BY revenue DESC

details.question: Which 5 products sold the most units? Show name and units.
details.sql:
WITH product_units AS (
    SELECT
        p.name,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.name
)
SELECT
    name,
    total_units
FROM product_units
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 5

details.question: Which city generated the most revenue? Give the city and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
details.sql:
WITH city_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.city,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS revenue
    FROM public.customers c
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY c.city
)
SELECT city, revenue
FROM city_revenue
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

details.question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_2025
FROM public.orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025

details.question: How many orders were placed in 2026?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_in_2026
FROM public.orders
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026

details.question: How many customers signed up in 2024?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_signed_up_2024
FROM public.customers
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM signup_date) = 2024

details.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS never_ordered_customers
FROM public.customers c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.orders o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.id
)

details.question: Who are the top 3 customers by number of orders? Show name and order count.
details.sql:
WITH customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.name,
        COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
    FROM public.customers c
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT
    name,
    order_count
FROM customer_order_counts
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 3

details.question: What is the average number of items (order lines) per order, rounded to 2 decimals?
details.sql:
WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        COUNT(oi.id) AS line_count
    FROM public.orders o
    LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY o.id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(line_count)::numeric, 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM order_counts

details.question: What is the average order value (sum of quantity times unit price per order), rounded to 2 decimals?
details.sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_value
    FROM public.order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(total_value)::numeric, 2) AS average_order_value
FROM order_totals

details.question: List products priced above 300 with their prices.
details.sql:
SELECT
    name,
    price
FROM public.products
WHERE price > 300
ORDER BY price DESC

details.question: How many products cost less than 50?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM public.products
WHERE price < 50

details.question: Which category has the most products?
details.sql:
SELECT
    p.category,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM public.products AS p
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 1

details.question: How many returned orders are there per city?
details.sql:
WITH returned_orders AS (
    SELECT o.id, c.city
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE o.status ILIKE 'returned'
)
SELECT city,
       COUNT(*) AS returned_order_count
FROM returned_orders
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY returned_order_count DESC

details.question: What share of orders were cancelled, as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals?
details.sql:
WITH total AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS total_orders
    FROM public.orders
),
cancelled AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS cancelled_orders
    FROM public.orders
    WHERE status = 'cancelled'
)
SELECT round(cancelled_orders::numeric / total_orders * 100, 2) AS cancelled_percentage
FROM total, cancelled

details.question: How many orders did business customers place?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS business_order_count
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.segment ILIKE 'business'

details.question: Revenue by customer segment, rounded to 2 decimals.
details.sql:
WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN public.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
    GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
    segment,
    ROUND(total_revenue, 2) AS revenue
FROM order_revenue
ORDER BY segment

details.question: What is the earliest order date?
details.sql:
SELECT MIN(order_date) AS earliest_order_date
FROM public.orders

details.question: What is the latest order date?
details.sql:
SELECT max(order_date) AS latest_order_date
FROM public.orders

details.question: How many distinct customers placed at least one order?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS distinct_customers
FROM public.orders o

details.question: Which product has never been ordered?
details.sql:
SELECT    p.id,
    p.name
FROM public.products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.order_items oi
    WHERE oi.product_id = p.id
)

details.question: How many pending orders are there in Hyderabad?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_orders
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status = 'pending'
  AND c.city = 'Hyderabad'

details.question: Total units of Dairy products sold.
details.sql:
WITH dairy_sales AS (
    SELECT oi.quantity
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    WHERE p.category = 'Dairy'
)
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units
FROM dairy_sales

details.question: What is the highest single order value (quantity times unit price summed per order), rounded to 2 decimals?
details.sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total
    FROM public.order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(total), 2) AS highest_order_value
FROM order_totals

details.question: Which order id has the highest order value?
details.sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_value
    FROM public.order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT
    order_id
FROM order_totals
ORDER BY total_value DESC
LIMIT 1

details.question: How many order lines have quantity 5?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_lines_with_quantity_5
FROM public.order_items
WHERE quantity = 5

details.question: Average price per category, rounded to 2 decimals.
details.sql:
SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS average_price
FROM public.products p
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

details.question: How many customers in Mumbai are business customers?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS business_customers_in_mumbai
FROM public.customers
WHERE city = 'Mumbai'
  AND segment = 'business'

details.question: Number of orders per customer segment.
details.sql:
WITH order_segments AS (
    SELECT
        c.segment,
        o.id AS order_id
    FROM public.orders AS o
    JOIN public.customers AS c
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
)
SELECT
    segment,
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment

details.question: Which 3 cities have the most delivered orders? Show city and count.
details.sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT c.city
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT
    city,
    COUNT(*) AS delivered_order_count
FROM delivered_orders
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC
LIMIT 3

details.question: How many customers have placed more than 10 orders?
details.sql:
WITH customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM public.orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_more_than_10_orders
FROM customer_order_counts

details.question: What is the name of the cheapest product in the Staples category?
details.sql:
SELECT p.name
FROM public.products p
WHERE p.category = 'Staples'
ORDER BY p.price ASC
LIMIT 1

details.question: Total revenue from the Fruits category in 2026, rounded to 2 decimals.
details.sql:
WITH fruit_items AS (
    SELECT
        oi.quantity,
        oi.unit_price
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN public.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    WHERE p.category = 'Fruits'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2026
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue
FROM fruit_items

details.question: How many orders were placed in October 2026?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM public.orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-10-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-11-01'

details.question: Which customer spent the most in total? Give name and amount rounded to 2 decimals.
details.sql:
WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.name,
        SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS total_spent
    FROM public.customers c
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT
    name,
    ROUND(total_spent, 2) AS total_spent
FROM customer_spending
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1

details.question: How many orders contain more than 3 distinct products?
details.sql:
WITH order_product_counts AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_products
    FROM public.order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_more_than_3_distinct_products
FROM order_product_counts
WHERE distinct_products > 3

details.question: How many products are in the Bakery category?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS bakery_product_count
FROM public.products
WHERE category = 'Bakery'

details.question: List the names of all Beverages products.
details.sql:
SELECT name
FROM public.products
WHERE category = 'Beverages'

details.question: How many orders have status shipped or pending?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM public.orders
WHERE status IN ('shipped', 'pending')

details.question: What is the total number of units sold of 'Paneer 200g'?
details.sql:
WITH paneer_sales AS (
    SELECT oi.quantity
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    WHERE p.name = 'Paneer 200g'
)
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM paneer_sales

details.question: How many cancelled orders did consumer-segment customers place?
details.sql:
WITH consumer_orders AS (
    SELECT o.id
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE c.segment = 'consumer'
      AND o.status = 'cancelled'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_count
FROM consumer_orders

details.question: Number of distinct products ordered by customers in Chennai.
details.sql:
WITH chennai_customers AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.customers
    WHERE city = 'Chennai'
),
chennai_orders AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.orders
    WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM chennai_customers)
),
chennai_order_items AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM chennai_orders)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_product_count
FROM chennai_order_items

details.question: Which category had the highest revenue? Name only.
details.sql:
WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT category
FROM category_revenue
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

details.question: How many customers signed up after June 30 2025?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_after_june_30_2025
FROM public.customers
WHERE signup_date > DATE '2025-06-30'

details.question: What is the average quantity per order line, rounded to 2 decimals?
details.sql:
SELECT round(avg(quantity)::numeric, 2) AS avg_quantity_per_line
FROM public.order_items

details.question: How many orders were returned in 2025?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS returned_orders_2025
FROM public.orders
WHERE status ILIKE 'returned'
  AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

details.question: Top 5 customers by total units purchased: name and units.
details.sql:
WITH customer_units AS (
    SELECT
        c.name,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units
    FROM public.customers c
    JOIN public.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT
    name,
    total_units
FROM customer_units
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 5

details.question: How many distinct cities have at least one business customer?
details.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS business_city_count
FROM public.customers
WHERE segment = 'business'
